From FastQ data to high-confidence variant calls: the Genome Analysis Toolkit best practices pipeline
Van der Auwera et al. Current Protocols in Bioinformatics 2013. PMC4243306.

Whole genome sequencing reads in FASTQ were aligned to the reference genome with BWA-MEM.
Duplicate reads were marked with Picard MarkDuplicates.
Base quality scores were recalibrated with GATK BaseRecalibrator.
Germline variants were called with GATK HaplotypeCaller following the GATK Best Practices.
The resulting VCF was filtered with variant quality score recalibration (VQSR).
